ma.getOpenUserInfo(Object object)

Call the interface to obtain user public information (minimum version: 24.3.0)

Parameter

Object object

Attribute Type Default Value Mandatory or Not Description
desc String No Purpose information. This parameter will be displayed in the permission popup.（Added in 26.6.0-LG0001）
success Function No Callback function for a successful API call.
fail Function No Callback function for a failed API call.
complete Function No Callback function used when an API call is complete. (This callback function is used whether the API call succeeds or fails.)

object.success Callback Function

Parameter
Object res
Attribute Type Description
errMsg String getOpenUserInfo: ok
userInfo Object User public information objects.
Object UserInfo
Attribute Type Description
nickName String User's Nickname
avatarUrl String User avatar image URL
country String User nationality

object.fail Callback Function

Parameter
Object res
Attribute Type Description
errMsg String error message
errno String error code

Usage Restrictions

  1. To use this interface, you need to connect to the Mini Program saas platform
  2. Using this interface requires the host application to implement and inject related functions such as obtaining user public information (please refer to the Mini Program SDK Integration Document--Integrating Third-Party Accounts without Login Guidance Chapter)

Sample Code

ma.getOpenUserInfo({
  desc: '',
  success(res) {
    console.log(res.userInfo.nickName);
    console.log(res.userInfo.avatarUrl);
    console.log(res.userInfo.country);
  }
});
